title: Campus Backbone Split
summary: Two upstream links share a 100 Mbps campus load. One link carries 20 Mbps more than the other.
concept: A traffic split is a system of linear equations. Each equation is a constraint on the unknown flow values; solving the system finds the flow that satisfies every constraint at once.
teachingNotes: The first row of the coefficient matrix is [1 1] because both links contribute to the total load.
The second row is [1 -1] because the difference between the two flows is fixed at 20 Mbps.
RREF turns the augmented matrix into a form where each row directly reads off one answer.
